title: Markdown Editor
tagline: A fast markdown editor with live preview, multiple documents, and real-time multi-user collaboration (Yjs + Cloudflare Durable Objects).
highlights: Live split-pane preview with a CodeMirror 6 editor, toolbar and Vim/Emacs modes
[[Wikilinks]] between documents with autocomplete and backlinks
Named workspaces with automatic version history
Real-time multi-user editing with a suggestion mode
Threaded, resolvable comments anchored to text
